idea-plugin.name: Demo Driver
idea-plugin.description:
Records screen demos of the IDE from a script, so a demo can be re-recorded after every change instead of performed by hand.

A tape describes the walkthrough in terms of code - "the text Baz on line 39" - and the plugin asks the editor where that actually is on screen. The real pointer then travels there, so takes look human while the targets stay exact across font, theme, zoom and window changes.

Needs ffmpeg on PATH for capture. Dev tooling; nothing runs unless you invoke it.

action.description: Replay the .tape file in the current editor and capture it
